subject.title: Add confirmation step to /new and /reset to prevent accidental session wipes

question: Should typed `/new` and hard `/reset` require a confirmation round-trip by default, and should that policy be configurable?
rationale: Current code, tests, and docs preserve unconfirmed typed commands, while the issue asks for a new default UX and possible config surface that repository policy treats as product/config-sensitive.

options.title: Confirm hard resets by default
options.body: Add a single short-lived repeat-command confirmation for typed `/new` and hard `/reset`, keep `/reset soft` exempt, and add cross-client tests before shipping.

options.title: Keep typed commands explicit
options.body: Preserve immediate typed command behavior and limit confirmation to visible UI buttons or future non-command affordances.

options.title: Add configurable confirmation
options.body: Add the confirmation plus a documented opt-out or step-count setting, accepting schema, docs, and upgrade-proof cost.

recommendation.title: Confirm hard resets by default
recommendation.body: Add a single short-lived repeat-command confirmation for typed `/new` and hard `/reset`, keep `/reset soft` exempt, and add cross-client tests before shipping.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the closest merged product decision on session-reset confirmation and explicitly scoped the typed-command behavior that this issue asks to revisit.
